references.disposition: That an affine chart inherits the prime-spectrum topology is the local compatibility statement that characterizes the scheme topology here; no separate identical topology is presumed.

references.disposition: Topology compatibility on charts is used to characterize scheme topology; this is not the constructible or étale topology.
